en-US.summary: Voice control for your ohMyBuying shopping lists.
en-US.description: Add, remove, and read items on your ohMyBuying shopping lists with your voice. Link your account with a one-time code from the ohMyBuying app, then say things like 'Alexa, open oh my buying' and then 'add eggs'. If you have more than one list, the skill asks which one and you answer with the list name.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask oh my buying to add eggs
Alexa, ask oh my buying what is on groceries
en-US.name: ohMyBuying

es-ES.summary: Control por voz de tus listas de compras de ohMyBuying.
es-ES.description: Añade, quita y lee elementos de tus listas de compras de ohMyBuying con la voz. Vincula tu cuenta con un código de un solo uso desde la aplicación, y luego di 'Alexa, abre oh my buying' y después 'añade huevos'. Si tienes más de una lista, la skill te pregunta cuál y respondes con el nombre de la lista.
examplePhrases: Alexa, pídele a oh my buying que añada huevos
Alexa, pregúntale a oh my buying qué hay en compras
es-ES.name: ohMyBuying

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: 1) Sign up at https://ohmybuying.vercel.app and create at least one list (e.g. 'Groceries'). 2) In the app header, open the Alexa panel and tap 'Generate code' to get a 6-character code. 3) Say 'Alexa, ask oh my buying to link with code <CODE>' — you should hear 'Your account is now linked.' Codes are single-use and expire in 10 minutes; generate a fresh one if needed. 4) Add an item with the two-step flow: say 'Alexa, open oh my buying', then 'add eggs'. If the account has more than one list the skill asks 'Which list?'; answer with a carrier phrase such as 'the groceries list'. If only one list exists it is used automatically. 5) Read it back: 'Alexa, ask oh my buying what is on groceries'. Note: naming the item and the list in a single sentence is not supported because both are AMAZON.SearchQuery slots; the item comes first and the list is confirmed in a follow-up turn.
